scripts.check:startup: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vp build && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler check startup --outfile .wrangler/worker-startup.cpuprofile
scripts.report:bundle: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vp build && node scripts/bundle-report.ts dist/hollware_spike_auth/index.js --packages
scripts.e2e:built: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false vp build && scripts/with-dev-server.sh 5240 /runtime '-c dist/hollware_spike_auth/wrangler.json' -- node scripts/e2e-built-worker.ts off
scripts.e2e:dev: WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false SPIKE_SERVER=vp scripts/with-dev-server.sh 5242 /runtime '' -- node scripts/e2e-built-worker.ts off
